description.value: Slow Hand Beer Company is a small BC-licensed craft brewery that brews a constantly rotating selection of small-batch beers skewing toward lighter, crisper, and sessionable styles with creative twists on world beer traditions. Their retail store and tasting lounge are hosted within Threefold Brewery at 1507 Powell St in Vancouver's Strathcona neighbourhood. The two-person operation — one owner focused on sales, one on brewing — keeps things intimate and craft-forward.
